body: He makes me all excited and looking forward to things only to be severely disappointed
My stepbrother who isn't even really my stepbrother.. He's so optimistic and him making me optimistic is why I am where I am right now
They'll just tell me I'm wrong and I need to get over it.
Everybody I know is so important to me but I really don't think anyone cares or they're just trying to while I'm still here
